title: Guest interns at the PEAR lab

tellings.quote:
And then I got in contact
with uh the pair lab. Yeah. Princeton
engineering anomalies research lab.

plain: A researcher appearing on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026 said that around 2003 they got in contact with the PEAR lab, the Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research lab in New Jersey, linked to Robert Jahn and Brenda Dunne. The guest says they interned there, and presents it as a formative step into research on unexplained things.
